The `d2j` range fix was filed under 2.0.0 in the changelog, but it landed
after 2.0.0 was published and so has never shipped. Move it to its own
2.0.1 section and date 2.0.0 to its actual publish date instead of leaving
it marked Unreleased.

First release published from CI with provenance.
